$comment: Run O1 lane K1 which: the Which character are you quiz of Inuyasha, written by us. Facts cited: inuyasha: inuyasha-inuyasha-name-053, inuyasha-inuyasha-lonely-childhood-088; kagome-higurashi: inuyasha-kagome-higurashi-name-055, inuyasha-kagome-higurashi-archery-056; miroku: inuyasha-miroku-name-058, inuyasha-miroku-wind-tunnel-059; sango: inuyasha-sango-name-061, inuyasha-sango-boomerang-062; shippo: inuyasha-shippo-name-064, inuyasha-shippo-pranks-089, inuyasha-shippo-surrogate-family-090; sesshomaru: inuyasha-sesshomaru-name-066, inuyasha-sesshomaru-disdain-091; kaede: inuyasha-kaede-name-074, inuyasha-kaede-beads-075, inuyasha-kaede-defended-village-093. Eight questions about the reader, premise level only, spoiler arc 0 scope both; seven profiles, all spoiler level 0 characters.

questions.question: A mossy old well in the garden hums when you walk by. What do you do?

options.text: Jump in before anyone can talk me out of it
Check the rim, the rope and the lid before I touch anything
Walk past with a raised eyebrow, since wells are not my business
Peek in, grin, and drop a pebble to see what happens

questions.question: Someone picks a fight with you in the street. How do you answer?

options.text: Loudly, and I do not back down an inch
With a joke so clever they forget why they were angry
I step in front of whoever they are really picking on
I do not answer at all, and let my record speak

questions.question: Your travelling group needs someone to take a job. You volunteer to:

options.text: Cook for everyone and keep spirits up
Scout ahead on my own and report back
Haggle with the villagers for food and a place to sleep
Keep watch through the night so nobody else has to
Instant ramen, hot, shared around the fire
Sweets, as many as my pockets hold
Plain rice and tea, the same as always
Nothing, I travel light and I do not snack

questions.question: You have a soft spot you would rather nobody noticed. What do you do with it?

options.text: Hide it behind a scowl and hope no one pokes it
Let it show, because feelings are meant to be shared
Turn it into a joke before anyone can say a word
Keep it so far inside that I almost forget it exists

questions.question: A friend is about to make a very bad bet. You:

options.text: Tell them straight that it is a terrible idea
Quietly pay for it, then say nothing about it
Place a smaller, smarter bet beside theirs and see who wins
Make them promise to be careful and then hug them

questions.question: Which sidekick would you bring along on a long trek?

options.text: A fast loyal pet that grows huge when it counts
A talkative friend who never stops asking questions
A trusty weapon I have spent years mastering
No one. A strong person walks alone

questions.question: A village elder hands you a charm that can calm your temper. You:

options.text: Wear it, grumbling the whole time
Thank them and wear it properly, since I try to keep the peace
Hand it to the person who really needs it, with a wink
Hand it back. I have never needed one

profile: You are proud and stubborn, and you rarely back down once you have decided.
Being on the outside of the crowd as a kid left its mark on you.
Under all that pride, you are far softer than you let anyone see.
You are the one who turns around when someone is in trouble.
You grow into your strengths, and you keep getting better at the hard things with practice.
You are kind first, and brave when it counts.
You are clever, a bit of a flirt, and you know it.
You have a habit of getting more out of wealthy clients than you should, and you do it with a straight face.
You carry a burden that was handed down to you, and you keep going.
You are seriously skilled at your trade, one of the best around.
Your job is a dangerous one, and you do it well.
You have a signature tool, a big one, and you handle it with real strength.
You are a born prankster, and you have never met a cheeky remark you could keep to yourself.
You say the blunt thing out loud, and the comic payback usually finds you.
You lost your family early, and the friends around you now feel like the family you chose.
You are the one people are wary of, and your reputation arrives before you do.
You are drawn to power and strength, and you do not hide it.
You are powerful, and everyone around you knows it.
You stand guard over your corner of the world.
You keep a firm hand on anyone who needs it, with a charm if that is what it takes.
You are unusually strong in your own right, and you do not need to announce it.
